title: Local scientific Python bridge
intro: Move from browser code to reproducible local Python: interpreter identity, safe files, pure functions, parameterized tests, SHA-256 and clean Git/venv replay.

scientific_context.caution: The browser cannot certify a real Windows/macOS clean checkout, a Git commit or an installed microscope pipeline.

chapter_method: Predict → Run → Investigate → independent Prove → delayed review; complete the local CLI/pytest checkout.

goals.title: Know which Python actually runs
goals.why: A Jupyter kernel can silently use a different Python environment from the terminal.
explain: Interpreter identity is an executable path, not a notebook label.
A package installed into one Python may be absent from another.
Record sys.executable and package versions in the real local checkpoint.

goals.title: Reject unsafe scientific-data paths
